_comment: Single source of truth for the prebuilt build-environment packages that
Daisium / Daisium_Predict / libOpenCyan CI otherwise compiles inside every
build run. `family` is the contract with the consumers: a CI step asks for one
family by name and gets the newest version this table produces. Changing a
family name means changing the consumer step that asks for it, so the name
carries everything that changes the bytes inside (SDK version, target list,
which repo's prep script produced the tree) and nothing that does not.
Trees are NOT shareable across repos just because two paths look alike:
Daisium's sysroot carries libxml2/libicu/zlib and a cross gcc+binutils,
Daisium_Predict's carries only the libc/libstdc++ pairs, and libOpenCyan's
third package set again - hence one family per producing script.
prepare/verify are run from this repo's workspace with the consumer checkouts
at the dirs named in `repos`. dest/markers use shell paths and glob patterns.

release.title: Prebuilt build-environment packages
release.notes: Toolchain trees that the Daisium / Daisium_Predict / libOpenCyan build scripts otherwise compile from source during a build. Consumed by those repos' CI through compile_scripts/tools/envpkg.sh, between actions/cache and the source build. Rebuilt on demand by .github/workflows/envpkgs_compiler.yaml; each asset carries .envpkg.json with the upstream commits, digests and glibc floor it was built from.

packages.desc: Hikari OLLVM 23 (clang+lld) built from source with LLVM_TARGETS=X86;LoongArch - the prebuilt clang23 release has no LoongArch backend, so linuxloong64 has to compile it
osxcross target tree (wrappers + cctools-ld64 + Apple SDK 11.3) built with Daisium/Daisium_Predict's recipe: UNATTENDED=1 + MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0, installed into the checkout's own target/
osxcross tool tree built through libOpenCyan's own prepare_osxcross.sh (TARGET_DIR driven, no deployment target pinned); that repo points OSXCROSS_ROOT straight at this dir
Debian buster amd64 sysroot (glibc 2.28 floor) + libxml2/libicu/zlib dev, produced by Daisium's prepare_x86_64_sysroot.sh
Debian buster i386 sysroot (glibc 2.28 floor) + libxml2/libicu/zlib dev, produced by Daisium's prepare_i386_sysroot.sh
Debian sid arm64 sysroot + libxml2/zlib dev + aarch64 cross gcc/binutils, produced by Daisium's prepare_aarch64_sysroot.sh
Debian sid loong64 sysroot + libxml2/zlib dev + loongarch64 cross gcc/binutils, produced by Daisium's prepare_loongarch64_sysroot.sh
Debian buster amd64 sysroot (glibc 2.28 floor), produced by Daisium_Predict's prepare_x86_64_sysroot.sh
Debian buster i386 sysroot (glibc 2.28 floor), produced by Daisium_Predict's prepare_i386_sysroot.sh
Debian sid arm64 sysroot (libc/libstdc++/libgcc pairs), produced by Daisium_Predict's prepare_aarch64_sysroot.sh
Debian sid loong64 sysroot (libc/libstdc++/libgcc pairs), produced by Daisium_Predict's prepare_loongarch64_sysroot.sh
Debian sid i386 sysroot for i686-unknown-linux-gnu, produced by libOpenCyan's prepare_debian_sysroot.sh
Debian sid arm64 sysroot for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, produced by libOpenCyan's prepare_debian_sysroot.sh
Debian sid loong64 sysroot for loongarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, produced by libOpenCyan's prepare_debian_sysroot.sh
